statement: The pinned generic HID Button usage ordinal rule explains why an explicit list of button usages must be selected to preserve intended Linux/SDL face semantics for standard-HID UHID, rather than assuming Xbox xpad BTN_X/BTN_Y defaults. B's EXP-0016 demonstrated a corrected virtual HID descriptor with neutral results across three SDL sessions, not actual Microsoft XUSB parity.
